metadata.task: If there is milk inside the refrigerator, place it on the counter; otherwise bring the juice instead.

plan.goal: Retrieve milk from the refrigerator and place it on the counter, or retrieve juice if milk is unavailable.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Navigate to the refrigerator area to access the appliance.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is at the Kitchen Entrance.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot is positioned at the Refrigerator.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill NAV_001 allows navigation to a specific object pose. The robot must reach the refrigerator to inspect its contents.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Inspect the refrigerator interior to determine if milk is present.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot has detected the presence or absence of milk inside the refrigerator.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill ENV_001 is required to open the refrigerator door to access the interior.
Skill PER_001 is required to perceive objects (Milk) inside the opened refrigerator.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Pick up the milk from the refrigerator.
checkpoints.entry_state: Refrigerator door is open; Milk is detected inside.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill MAN_001 is required to grasp and pick up the milk bottle from the refrigerator shelf.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Place the milk on the counter.
checkpoints.exit_state: Milk is placed on the counter.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill MAN_002 is required to move the held milk to the target pose on the counter.

checkpoints.entry_state: Milk is on the counter; Refrigerator door is open.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill ENV_002 is required to close the refrigerator door after retrieving the milk.

constraints: Robot is fixed-base and cannot navigate to other rooms if milk is not in the refrigerator.
Robot has limited payload capacity; ensure milk fits within limits.

execution_summary.expected_outcome: Milk is successfully retrieved from the refrigerator and placed on the counter. If milk was not detected during Checkpoint 2, the plan would branch to retrieve juice instead.
